triggeredRules.title: MonoGame package pinned below 3.8.6.1
triggeredRules.explanation: The project already uses a MonoGame 3.8 package but pins an older version. The 3.8 line fixes bugs and adds net8.0 support. Packages not named MonoGame.Framework.* (for example MonoGame.Extended) are not checked, because they have their own versions.
triggeredRules.resolution: The migrator updates the MonoGame package versions, the target framework and the dotnet-mgcb tool manifest to 3.8.6.1.

triggeredRules.title: Older .NET target (netcoreapp3.1, net5.0, net6.0, net7.0)
triggeredRules.explanation: The project targets a .NET version that is out of support. MonoGame 3.8.2 and later build for net8.0.
triggeredRules.resolution: The migrator sets the target framework to net8.0 or net8.0-windows.
